name: Elm
source:
A somewhat quiet young man who's Lucie & Cecil's classmate. Despite being cordial with others, he doesn't open up easily. Unbeknownst to Lucie, he's Rowan's younger twin brother.

"My father devoted himself to his work, and since my mother died he's barely shared a living space with me, let alone a meal. And my brother..."

Dislikes: sudden physical contact, braggarts
Likes: helping people learn, gardens

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/]Steam[/url]]
